list.emptyBody: Open a scenario and choose “Compare environments” to run it in two environments of its site.

start.title: Compare environments
start.warning: The whole scenario runs once in each environment. Avoid scenarios that change data, such as orders or payments.
start.toleranceHint: Screens whose difference is at or below this are the same. 0 to 100.
start.needTwo: This site needs at least two environments to compare.
start.noScreenshot: Add a screenshot step first: comparisons look at screenshot steps only.

reason.different_site: Both environments must belong to the scenario's site.
reason.same_base_url: The two environments have the same base address.
reason.no_screenshot_step: The scenario has no screenshot step.
reason.auth_session_missing_left: Save your own login session for the left environment first.
reason.auth_session_missing_right: Save your own login session for the right environment first.
reason.app_update_required: Update the desktop app to run comparisons.

detail.title: Comparison
detail.maskingOn: Site selectors and automatic detection: on
detail.maskingOff: Site selectors and automatic detection: off for this scenario
detail.counts: Moved {moved} · Left only {removed} · Right only {added} · Changed {changed}

explain.different: Over the tolerance, or the structure differs.
explain.incomparable: Conditions didn't allow a fair comparison.

reason.child_failed: A run failed at this step
reason.masking_failed: The structure couldn't be masked, so it wasn't kept
reason.too_large: The structure is over the size limit
reason.too_many_lines: The structure has too many lines
reason.diff_timeout: The structure diff took too long; only the verdict is shown
reason.too_many_edits: Too many changes to show the diff
